SELECT count(DISTINCT t.id_student || '-' || t.code_module || '-' || t.code_presentation) 
FROM studentRegistration t 
JOIN studentAssessment sa ON t.id_student = sa.id_student 
JOIN assessments a ON sa.id_assessment = a.id_assessment AND t.code_module = a.code_module AND t.code_presentation = a.code_presentation
WHERE t.date_unregistration IS NOT NULL
